name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PLR.sibling_identity
title: Sibling identity of GGH15-style path values: y_{xb} = y_{xb'} D_{b'}^{-1} D_b, and the whole subtree below xb follows
statement: Over a commutative ring R, let y assign to every word x over an alphabet beta a matrix y_x (iota x n) with y_{xc} = y_x D_c for every word x and letter c, where D_c are n x n matrices. If det D_{b'} is a unit, then y_{xb} = y_{xb'} D_{b'}^{-1} D_b, and more generally y_{x b z} = y_{xb'} D_{b'}^{-1} D_b D_{z_1} ... D_{z_r} for every word z = z_1 ... z_r.
